user.title: Connect to the rental management tool
user.description: Tool address (e.g. location.pitap.com) and access key created in My account → External API.

logements.title: Units to control
logements.description: Choose the units of this building. The building is occupied as soon as one of its units is (common areas). Add the integration once per building.

reauth_confirm.title: New access key
reauth_confirm.description: The tool rejects the stored key. Create a new one in My account → External API.

error.cle_refusee: Key rejected: missing, invalid or revoked.
error.injoignable: Tool unreachable: check the https address and that the API is installed.
error.aucun_logement: No unit available with this key.

abort.already_configured: These units are already controlled by another entry.

init.title: Settings
init.description: Choose what to configure, then “Finish and save”.

general.title: General
general.description: Weather entity with hourly forecast: cooling is used on arrival only if the 2–4 pm forecast exceeds the unit threshold. Without weather: always heating.

cible.title: {nom}
cible.description: Stay: bedroom / living setpoint when heating (guest adjusts between min and max); cooling: setpoint = max, guest cannot go below. Between close stays: in-between temperature. Vacant: min temperature.

data.jours_inter: In-between if gap is less than

equipements.title: {nom}: equipment ({nombre})
equipements.description: Ventilation, water heater, lights… on from “before arrival” until departure + offset, kept on between stays closer than the given days. Scripts run at start; automations are enabled then disabled.

data.jours_maintien: Kept on between stays if less than

logements.title: Building units
logements.description: Tick the units controlled in this building. A removed unit loses its settings and entities. Applied on “Finish and save”.

error.min_sup_max: Min temperature must be lower than max.

abort.cle_refusee: Key rejected by the tool: update it.
